description: Parse DMARC reports read from its PostgreSQL database: senders, policies, reporters and TLS-RPT failure details

panels.description: Reports that begin in the time range, and the messages they count by class

targets.rawSql:
SELECT rep.reports AS "Reports",
       rep.messages AS "Messages",
       rep.pass_rate AS "Pass rate",
       c.unaligned AS "Unaligned",
       c.unauthenticated AS "Unauthenticated"
FROM (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS reports,
         COALESCE(SUM(r.total_messages), 0) AS messages,
         100.0 * SUM(r.compliant_messages) / NULLIF(SUM(r.total_messages), 0) AS pass_rate
  FROM reports r
  WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(r.date_begin)
    AND r.domain = ANY(ARRAY[$domain]::text[])
) rep, (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rec.count) FILTER (WHERE rec.auth_class = 'unaligned'), 0) AS unaligned,
         COALESCE(SUM(rec.count) FILTER (WHERE rec.auth_class = 'unauthenticated'), 0) AS unauthenticated
  FROM reports r
  JOIN records rec ON rec.report_id = r.id
  WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(r.date_begin)
    AND r.domain = ANY(ARRAY[$domain]::text[])
) c

panels.title: Summary

panels.description: The end of the newest report per domain over all stored reports, as the posture metrics count it: the time range does not apply. Unaligned: SPF or DKIM passed for another domain. Unauthenticated: nothing passed.

targets.rawSql:
WITH dmarc AS (
  SELECT r.domain, MAX(r.date_end) AS last_report
  FROM reports r
  WHERE r.domain = ANY(ARRAY[$domain]::text[])
  GROUP BY r.domain
),
classes AS (
  SELECT r.domain,
         MAX(r.date_end) FILTER (WHERE rec.auth_class = 'unaligned') AS last_unaligned,
         MAX(r.date_end) FILTER (WHERE rec.auth_class = 'unauthenticated') AS last_unauthenticated
  FROM records rec
  JOIN reports r ON r.id = rec.report_id
  WHERE rec.auth_class IN ('unaligned', 'unauthenticated')
    AND r.domain = ANY(ARRAY[$domain]::text[])
  GROUP BY r.domain
),
tls AS (
  SELECT p.policy_domain AS domain,
         MAX(t.date_end) AS last_report,
         MAX(t.date_end) FILTER (WHERE p.failed_sessions > 0) AS last_failure
  FROM tlsrpt_policies p
  JOIN tlsrpt_reports t ON t.id = p.report_id
  WHERE p.policy_domain = ANY(ARRAY[$domain]::text[])
  GROUP BY p.policy_domain
)
SELECT COALESCE(d.domain, tls.domain) AS "Domain",
       to_timestamp(d.last_report) AS "DMARC report",
       to_timestamp(c.last_unaligned) AS "Unaligned record",
       to_timestamp(c.last_unauthenticated) AS "Unauthenticated record",
       to_timestamp(tls.last_report) AS "TLS-RPT report",
       to_timestamp(tls.last_failure) AS "TLS failure"
FROM dmarc d
LEFT JOIN classes c ON c.domain = d.domain
FULL JOIN tls ON tls.domain = d.domain
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Last Report per Domain

panels.description: Messages per day by class: pass (aligned), unaligned (SPF or DKIM passed for another domain), unauthenticated (nothing passed). A report counts on the day its period begins.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__unixEpochGroupAlias(r.date_begin, '1d'),
       COALESCE(SUM(rec.count) FILTER (WHERE rec.auth_class = 'pass'), 0) AS pass,
       COALESCE(SUM(rec.count) FILTER (WHERE rec.auth_class = 'unaligned'), 0) AS unaligned,
       COALESCE(SUM(rec.count) FILTER (WHERE rec.auth_class = 'unauthenticated'), 0) AS unauthenticated
FROM reports r
JOIN records rec ON rec.report_id = r.id
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(r.date_begin)
  AND r.domain = ANY(ARRAY[$domain]::text[])
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Messages by Class

panels.description: Share of messages that passed DMARC (aligned SPF or DKIM) per domain and day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__unixEpochGroupAlias(r.date_begin, '1d'),
       r.domain AS metric,
       100.0 * SUM(r.compliant_messages) / NULLIF(SUM(r.total_messages), 0) AS pass_rate
FROM reports r
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(r.date_begin)
  AND r.domain = ANY(ARRAY[$domain]::text[])
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: DMARC Pass Rate per Domain

panels.description: Sources whose mail passed SPF or DKIM for a domain other than the From domain: a service sending on the domain's behalf without alignment, or a forwarder. The SPF and DKIM columns name the domains that passed. The PTR shows only when it resolves back to the address.

targets.rawSql:
WITH unaligned AS (
  SELECT rec.source_ip, rec.header_from, rec.envelope_from, rec.count,
         rec.spf_domains, rec.dkim_domains, r.org_name
  FROM reports r
  JOIN records rec ON rec.report_id = r.id
  WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(r.date_begin)
    AND r.domain = ANY(ARRAY[$domain]::text[])
    AND rec.auth_class = 'unaligned'
),
top AS (
  SELECT source_ip,
         SUM(count) AS messages,
         string_agg(DISTINCT header_from, ', ') AS header_from,
         string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(envelope_from, ''), ', ') AS envelope_from,
         COUNT(DISTINCT org_name) AS reporters
  FROM unaligned
  GROUP BY source_ip
  ORDER BY messages DESC
  LIMIT 50
),
results AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT source_ip, spf_domains, dkim_domains
  FROM unaligned
  WHERE source_ip IN (SELECT source_ip FROM top)
),
passed AS (
  SELECT u.source_ip,
         string_agg(DISTINCT a.domain, ', ') FILTER (WHERE a.method = 'spf') AS spf,
         string_agg(DISTINCT a.domain, ', ') FILTER (WHERE a.method = 'dkim') AS dkim
  FROM results u
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT 'spf' AS method, e->>'Domain' AS domain, e->>'Result' AS result
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(u.spf_domains) = 'array' THEN u.spf_domains ELSE '[]' END) e
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'dkim', e->>'Domain', e->>'Result'
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(u.dkim_domains) = 'array' THEN u.dkim_domains ELSE '[]' END) e
  ) a
  WHERE a.result = 'pass'
  GROUP BY u.source_ip
)
SELECT t.source_ip AS "Source IP",
       src.name AS "Service",
       CASE WHEN src.reverse_dns_verified THEN src.reverse_dns END AS "Verified PTR",
       CASE WHEN src.asn > 0 THEN concat_ws(' ', 'AS' || src.asn, NULLIF(src.as_name, '')) END AS "AS",
       src.country AS "Country",
       t.header_from AS "Header From",
       t.envelope_from AS "Envelope From",
       p.spf AS "SPF passed for",
       p.dkim AS "DKIM passed for",
       t.reporters AS "Reporters",
       t.messages AS "Messages"
FROM top t
LEFT JOIN passed p ON p.source_ip = t.source_ip
LEFT JOIN sources src ON src.ip = t.source_ip
ORDER BY t.messages DESC

panels.title: Top Unaligned Senders

panels.description: Sources whose mail passed neither SPF nor DKIM for any domain: spoofing, or a sender that is not set up at all. Dispositions show what receivers did with it. The PTR shows only when it resolves back to the address.

targets.rawSql:
WITH top AS (
  SELECT rec.source_ip,
         SUM(rec.count) AS messages,
         string_agg(DISTINCT rec.header_from, ', ') AS header_from,
         string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(rec.envelope_from, ''), ', ') AS envelope_from,
         string_agg(DISTINCT rec.disposition, ', ') AS dispositions,
         COUNT(DISTINCT r.org_name) AS reporters
  FROM reports r
  JOIN records rec ON rec.report_id = r.id
  WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(r.date_begin)
    AND r.domain = ANY(ARRAY[$domain]::text[])
    AND rec.auth_class = 'unauthenticated'
  GROUP BY rec.source_ip
  ORDER BY messages DESC
  LIMIT 50
)
SELECT t.source_ip AS "Source IP",
       src.name AS "Service",
       CASE WHEN src.reverse_dns_verified THEN src.reverse_dns END AS "Verified PTR",
       CASE WHEN src.asn > 0 THEN concat_ws(' ', 'AS' || src.asn, NULLIF(src.as_name, '')) END AS "AS",
       src.country AS "Country",
       t.header_from AS "Header From",
       t.envelope_from AS "Envelope From",
       t.dispositions AS "Dispositions",
       t.reporters AS "Reporters",
       t.messages AS "Messages"
FROM top t
LEFT JOIN sources src ON src.ip = t.source_ip
ORDER BY t.messages DESC

panels.title: Top Unauthenticated Sources

panels.description: Each policy the reports saw published, with the first and last report that carried it. np and testing come from RFC 9990 reports, which have no pct. Reporters that cached an older record overlap.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.domain AS "Domain",
       NULLIF(r.policy_p, '') AS "p",
       NULLIF(r.policy_sp, '') AS "sp",
       NULLIF(r.policy_np, '') AS "np",
       NULLIF(r.policy_adkim, '') AS "adkim",
       NULLIF(r.policy_aspf, '') AS "aspf",
       CASE WHEN r.schema_version = '2.0' THEN NULL ELSE r.policy_pct END AS "pct",
       NULLIF(r.policy_testing, '') AS "testing",
       COUNT(*) AS "Reports",
       COUNT(DISTINCT r.org_name) AS "Reporters",
       to_timestamp(MIN(r.date_begin)) AS "First seen",
       to_timestamp(MAX(r.date_end)) AS "Last seen"
FROM reports r
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(r.date_begin)
  AND r.domain = ANY(ARRAY[$domain]::text[])
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8
ORDER BY 1, "Last seen" DESC

panels.title: Published Policies

panels.description: Messages per disposition the receivers applied, by class. Unauthenticated mail with disposition none is mail the published policy did not stop.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(rec.disposition, ''), 'unknown') AS disposition,
       SUM(rec.count) FILTER (WHERE rec.auth_class = 'pass') AS pass,
       SUM(rec.count) FILTER (WHERE rec.auth_class = 'unaligned') AS unaligned,
       SUM(rec.count) FILTER (WHERE rec.auth_class = 'unauthenticated') AS unauthenticated
FROM reports r
JOIN records rec ON rec.report_id = r.id
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(r.date_begin)
  AND r.domain = ANY(ARRAY[$domain]::text[])
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Dispositions by Class

panels.description: The reasons receivers reported for applying a disposition other than the published policy, such as forwarded or mailing_list, and the reporters that gave them

targets.rawSql:
WITH overridden AS (
  SELECT rec.override_reasons, rec.auth_class, rec.disposition, r.org_name,
         SUM(rec.count) AS messages
  FROM reports r
  JOIN records rec ON rec.report_id = r.id
  WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(r.date_begin)
    AND r.domain = ANY(ARRAY[$domain]::text[])
    AND jsonb_typeof(rec.override_reasons) = 'array'
    AND rec.override_reasons <> '[]'
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
)
SELECT o->>'Type' AS "Reason",
       NULLIF(o->>'Comment', '') AS "Comment",
       g.auth_class AS "Class",
       g.disposition AS "Disposition",
       string_agg(DISTINCT g.org_name, ', ') AS "Reporters",
       SUM(g.messages) AS "Messages"
FROM overridden g
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(g.override_reasons) o
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
ORDER BY "Messages" DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Policy Overrides

panels.description: Organizations sending aggregate reports for the selected domains

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.org_name AS "Reporter",
       COUNT(*) AS "Reports",
       COUNT(DISTINCT r.domain) AS "Domains",
       COALESCE(SUM(r.total_messages), 0) AS "Messages",
       100.0 * SUM(r.compliant_messages) / NULLIF(SUM(r.total_messages), 0) AS "Pass rate",
       to_timestamp(MAX(r.date_end)) AS "Last report"
FROM reports r
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(r.date_begin)
  AND r.domain = ANY(ARRAY[$domain]::text[])
GROUP BY r.org_name
ORDER BY "Messages" DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Reporters

panels.description: SMTP TLS Reporting (RFC 8460) sessions per policy domain and day: successful on the left axis, failed under the domain's MTA-STS or DANE policy as red bars on the right axis

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__unixEpochGroupAlias(t.date_begin, '1d'),
       p.policy_domain,
       SUM(p.successful_sessions) AS successful,
       SUM(p.failed_sessions) AS failed
FROM tlsrpt_reports t
JOIN tlsrpt_policies p ON p.report_id = t.id
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(t.date_begin)
  AND p.policy_domain = ANY(ARRAY[$domain]::text[])
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: TLS Sessions per Policy Domain

panels.description: Failed TLS sessions in the time range by RFC 8460 result type

targets.rawSql:
SELECT f.result_type AS "Result type",
       SUM(f.failed_sessions) AS "Sessions"
FROM tlsrpt_reports t
JOIN tlsrpt_policies p ON p.report_id = t.id
JOIN tlsrpt_failures f ON f.policy_id = p.id
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(t.date_begin)
  AND p.policy_domain = ANY(ARRAY[$domain]::text[])
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Failed TLS Sessions by Result Type

panels.description: Failed sessions grouped by cause and endpoints, as the reporters described them: the receiving MX and address, the sending MTA, and the reason code

targets.rawSql:
SELECT p.policy_domain AS "Policy domain",
       p.policy_type AS "Policy",
       f.result_type AS "Result type",
       NULLIF(f.receiving_mx_hostname, '') AS "Receiving MX",
       NULLIF(f.receiving_ip, '') AS "Receiving IP",
       NULLIF(f.sending_mta_ip, '') AS "Sending MTA",
       NULLIF(f.failure_reason_code, '') AS "Reason code",
       string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(f.additional_information, ''), ' ') AS "Additional information",
       string_agg(DISTINCT t.org_name, ', ') AS "Reporters",
       SUM(f.failed_sessions) AS "Sessions",
       to_timestamp(MAX(t.date_end)) AS "Last seen"
FROM tlsrpt_reports t
JOIN tlsrpt_policies p ON p.report_id = t.id
JOIN tlsrpt_failures f ON f.policy_id = p.id
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(t.date_begin)
  AND p.policy_domain = ANY(ARRAY[$domain]::text[])
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7
ORDER BY "Sessions" DESC
LIMIT 100
